objective: Separate model discrepancy from parameter uncertainty formally on the hump, where a two-leg record already shows a bias no coefficient setting removes, and give band-containment campaigns a proper scoring rule instead of a pass-or-fail containment call
rationale: The hump is the right case because the lab has already run the experiment that distinguishes the two sources without having framed it that way. Reproduction is exact: separation and reattachment land within a ten-thousandth and three ten-thousandths of the earlier record against a five-thousandth tolerance. Against experiment the split is stark and stable: separation sits at minus 1.59 percent and passes, reattachment at plus 13.92 percent and fails, and the constitutive arm moves reattachment by 0.0022 chord against a bar of 0.010 and in the wrong direction. The coefficient arm is the parameter leg and it is informative precisely because it is large and insufficient, moving reattachment by 0.0498, about five times the bar, toward experiment while still leaving plus 9.4 percent. That residual, the part no admissible coefficient setting removes, is the discrepancy the strategy asks to be separated formally, and the second leg supports it being systematic rather than case-specific, since the same constitutive change on the periodic hills moves 0.034 step heights away from the band against a bar of 0.10, while on the ducts the same term is large and helpful. The closure-family band on the same case gives the parameter leg its spread already, with a four-closure channel spanning a band that contains the experimental value and a full band running from minus 52 percent to plus 14 percent whose lower edge the record itself flags as a diverged run, which is a containment claim resting partly on a run that should not be in it. That is the second half of the clause: a containment campaign that answers yes or no cannot distinguish a band that contains truth narrowly from one that contains it by being uselessly wide or by including a bad member, and a proper scoring rule can. Axis A: reading-kind, priced from this case's own measured solves. Axis B: 0. Axis C: 0, and see the in-sample statement.

cost_basis: measured on this exact case and mesh: the baseline solve cost 5.58 core-min and the constitutive arm 4.71 core-min at the same rank count on the 51,626-cell mesh, so a designed sweep of about ten coefficient settings plus two repeats comes to about 60 core-min; the earlier 60 core-min forecast for this same case missed its measured cost by a factor near ten, and that forecast is disclosed here and is explicitly not the basis for this number
expected_knowledge_gain: Three outcomes that change what the lab may claim. One: the discrepancy term is identifiable and its posterior excludes zero, which means the reattachment bias is formally attributed to model form rather than to coefficient choice, and the epistemic showcase gains its central claim with a statistical statement behind it. Two: parameter uncertainty and discrepancy are not separately identifiable from the available data, which is the classic failure mode of this framework and is worth demonstrating on our own case rather than reading about, because it tells the lab exactly what additional data would break the tie. Three: the scoring rule ranks the existing band-containment results and changes their ordering relative to the pass-or-fail call, which would say the current containment reporting is hiding quality differences, starting with the band whose lower edge is a diverged member.
in_sample_verdict: Named rather than waved through, because this case family touches the scored list. The work runs on the validation configuration of the hump against its experimental reference, and its product is a diagnostic discrepancy statement, not a corrected field. The hard boundary: no discrepancy model fitted here may be carried into anything that produces a scored column, and no output of this item may enter a submission package. If a later filing proposes carrying a fitted discrepancy to the scored wall-mounted hump case, that filing is in-sample by construction and owes its own refusal or its own justification; this one does not grant it.

gate: STRATEGY PROOF CLAUSE, verbatim: 'Calibration & validation theory: Kennedy-O'Hagan framework -> PROOF: model discrepancy formally separated from parameter uncertainty on one case (the hump is perfect); band-containment campaigns get a scoring rule.' Operationalised in two halves, both required. Half one: a fitted separation on the hump reporting a posterior for the calibration parameter and a posterior for the discrepancy term, with the identifiability question answered explicitly rather than assumed, and with the reattachment residual that the coefficient arm cannot remove attributed by the fit rather than by argument. Half two: a scoring rule for band containment, stated before it is applied, that rewards a narrow band containing truth over a wide one and penalises a band whose members include a run the record itself flags as diverged, applied retrospectively to the existing bands including the four-closure hump band and the model-form groups. A containment verdict that stays binary fails half two. BLOCKED UNTIL POST-SEND per the body.
